Oscar Rodríguez Rocha

Research Engineer

Ph.D. in Computer and Control Engineering


Advancing the frontiers of Artificial Intelligence to make information discoverable, learning adaptive, experiences personalized, and AI more responsible and sustainable.

I’m currently an AI Engineer at LumApps, where I focus on AI-driven search relevance and personalization. I’m also a co-founder of GreenMinds, a non-profit promoting responsible and sustainable AI.

My main interests are:

  • Search Relevance and Personalization
  • Generative AI (LLMs, RAG)
  • Recommender Systems
  • Graph-based Machine Learning - Graph Representation Learning (GRL)
  • Responsible & Sustainable AI

Previously, I was the Head of AI at Teach on Mars, leading innovation in e-learning with LLMs, semantic search, and graph-based recommendation systems.

I’m an external collaborator of WIMMICS, a joint research team between Inria Sophia-Antipolis Sophia Antipolis - Méditerranée and I3S (CNRS and Université Côte d’Azur), where I worked for almost 5 years doing research on AI in education. I also worked previously as a postdoc researcher at the Politecnico di Torino in Italy for the SoftEng research group and I hold a PhD in Information and Systems Engineering obtained also from the Politecnico di Torino.
